note: The three hand-written motors that had been in the app since its first day are gone - an A8-3, B6-4 and C6-5 with invented thrust curves, the C6-5 18 percent high on impulse. v0.105 fixed the importer that preferred them but left them in place; that was the wrong fix. Every catalogued motor now flies with no network: all 1,075 published thrust curves ship with the app. The motor catalogue is refreshed after two months (26 new motors, AeroTech I218R corrected 330 to 319.63 Ns, Estes E12 marked out of production). A motor with several published curves now gets the one that matches its certification - every Estes A8 had been flying the A8-0 booster curve, about 7 percent low. Thirty-nine catalogue parts carried a density no material can have (eighteen paper rings at a hundred-thousandth of air) and are corrected. And the v0.104/v0.105 changelog is corrected where it was wrong, including a roll-inertia figure ten times too large and a headline that was far too broad.
